_comment: Build-context images for this app. CI (the image-build job in .github/workflows/ci.yml) iterates `images` as a matrix, so it is never hardcoded to backend+frontend: add an entry here to build a new container automatically. `service` is the image name suffix: on a push to main publish-images pushes ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>-<service> (lowercased) as :main, :sha-<short> and :v0.N (docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, Releases); compose.prod.yml pulls ${IMAGE_REPO}-<service>:${IMAGE_TAG} and compose.build.yml (local builds only) uses the same contexts.
